Name: (Portrait) Hiiragiu's Short-haired Elliott
Author: hiiragiu
Description:
[font=Times New Roman][size=3]We can all agree that Elliott's long hair is absolutely gorgeous, but it may not be everyone's cup of tea. This mod alters his haircut, as well as changes his outfit from a suit, into a crimson red long sleeve polo with a white undershirt. I also changed his skin tone a bit, but only for his hair to better fit the rest of his body - which is hopefully not too noticeable.[/size]

[b]Installation Instructions:

1. Unzip the downloaded .zip file. It contains the mod folder, and you should end up with a folder titled 'Hiiragiu's Short-haired Elliott.'
2. Move the extracted folder into your Mods folder, inside your Stardew Valley save location.[/b][/font]

Manifest.Name: Hiiragiu's Short-haired Elliott
Manifest.Description: A mod that shortens Elliott's hair.
